Sample Matrix.csv.role: candidate survey availability matrix; role must be confirmed from bounded header before rows

Sample Data.csv.role: candidate survey effort/covariate table; role must be confirmed from bounded header before rows

current_gate.site_locations: open full payload once, verify exact MD5/size, report schema and response-independent site registry/coordinates
current_gate.sample_matrix: read one byte at a time and stop at first CR or LF; maximum 4096 header bytes; no row/value access
current_gate.sample_data: read one byte at a time and stop at first CR or LF; maximum 4096 header bytes; no row/value access
current_gate.geometry: do not define coordinate field mapping until Site Locations physical schema is observed; once observed it must be frozen before structural ladder computation

focal_species.rule: must be selected later by an external response-independent rule; response prevalence/event counts are forbidden
